cases.prompt: Reconcile all my applications from the tracker, portals, and messages.
cases.fixture: On review date 2027-02-06, Saved and Applied tracker pages load but the remaining requested views require sign-in. A handoff observed R-510 In Review on 2027-02-03. A direct exact R-510 employer decision dated 2027-02-05 is found on 2027-02-06. A forwarded preview only mentions an unrelated role. The canonical record has 24 rows, 17 with submission dates.
expect: Track each requested surface and view separately with pagination and exact-identity coverage
Keep the February 3 handoff as historical, use the February 5 R-510 decision, and record the February 6 observation and review separately
Distinguish 24 records and 17 dated rows from verified current application outcomes
Mark the run partial and give a next owner for each material gap
cases.failure_consequence: Portfolio reported synchronized despite missing evidence

cases.prompt: Check whether my employer application and recruiter referral went through.
cases.fixture: R-510 has an exact receipt for Quick Apply and the full form still shows Review and Submit. R-511 was sent to a staffing recruiter with no downstream receipt. R-512 has one internal candidate application under review and a different external application closed.
expect: Record Quick Apply receipt and keep full application unsubmitted
Record recruiter delivery and keep client submission unconfirmed
Retain the internal and external route outcomes separately for R-512
Avoid reapplying or overwriting route-specific history
cases.failure_consequence: Unverified downstream submission promoted or active application closed

cases.prompt: Sync current status and notes across both trackers.
cases.fixture: A verified decision supports closing R-610. The canonical row is already corrected by an owner. An existing mirror note changes between plan and write; the new note contains a different update. The prior note save may still be in flight, and an immediate read does not find its event key.
expect: Verify the already-correct canonical row without a duplicate write
Re-read and reconcile the mirror change before editing
Hold unresolved conflicts, including blind replacements with unverified exclusive ownership, and record the current evidence and owner
Do not report a blocked mirror as synchronized
Leave the uncertain save pending unless the retry is idempotent or the first attempt is confirmed failed
cases.failure_consequence: Duplicate notes or overwritten concurrent work

cases.prompt: Apply the confirmed rejection to my tracker and application record.
cases.fixture: Employer declined exact R-820. The owner authorizes stage corrections. The job tracker requires discarding an existing draft before changing the row to Archived. The application record can be corrected independently.
expect: Set the exact application record to closed and verify it
Hold the tracker archive because draft discard is a separate action
Preserve the draft and historical receipt
Report the blocked tracker change and its dependency
cases.failure_consequence: Unapproved discard or false cross-surface verification

cases.prompt: Close the declined application in my records and job tracker.
cases.fixture: R-730 has distinct internal and external candidate applications. The internal route last showed active. A rejection names only employer and R-730. It omits route, candidate application ID, and tracker crosswalk. The user authorizes exact stage corrections.
expect: Retain the known route-specific observations
Record the rejection as unmatched evidence
Hold route-dependent disposition and tracker changes
Name the missing route, candidate application ID, or tracker crosswalk
cases.failure_consequence: A decision for one application closes a different candidate route
